wake_source.responsibility: Start a fresh reasoning invocation at the next supported opportunity.

reasoning_worker.responsibility: Perform useful checkpointable work while invocation exists.

durable_continuation.responsibility: Persist exact resumable state and side-effect evidence after meaningful units.

supervisor_measurement.responsibility: Detect stale workers, recover ownership, and measure useful coverage/dead gaps without inference.

scheduler_budget.rule: Under the rolling scheduler, measure actual wake-to-work, work-to-final-rearm, and final-rearm-to-next-wake intervals. Do not infer a quarter-boundary deadline that no longer governs production. Preserve pre-migration fixed-quarter budget classifications as historical evidence only.

conditions: useful admissible work remained or fallback continuation was required
no terminal or committed handoff evidence exists
response: do not infer useful work across the gap
recover at next available verified wake
if repeated, target wake/runtime adapter rather than adding policy prose

rolling_recovery.startup: minimum fence then provisional same-canonical rearm before full restore/substantive work
rolling_recovery.normal_close: checkpoint then same-canonical final rearm to actual close + configured offset and verify
rolling_recovery.mutation_failure: retry once when safe; if older verified future continuation survives, classify DEGRADED_CONTINUATION within its safety envelope; otherwise fail closed before conflicting substantive side effects
rolling_recovery.stale_occurrence: recover forward to newest verified schedule and never roll DTSTART or authority backward
